fact: The Minister of Education inaugurated the 25-member Nigerian Education Data Initiative (NEDI) Implementation Committee, which he chairs, and tasked it with developing and executing a roadmap for a Nigerian Education Databank tracking every student from early childhood to tertiary by National Identity Number; the statement says 'today' and carries no date in its text, so the page's publication date is used.
title: NEDI: Pioneering Data-Driven Transformation in Nigeria's Education Sector
publisher: Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation
